svg.aria-label: A module manifest JSON document goes to a draft 2020-12 JSON Schema validator loaded with module-manifest.schema.json, one of 13 schema documents in semantic/v1/. The validator answers true when the document has the required properties manifest_version, name, version, and false with the missing property named when it does not.
